name: subtitle-generator-davinci-resolve
title: 自动生成视频字幕
description: Get captioned video files ready to post, without touching a single slider. Upload your video files (MP4, MOV, AVI, MKV, up to 500MB), say something like "generate subtitles for my DaVinci Resolve video and export as MP4 with burned-in captions", and download 1080p MP4 when it's done. Built for video editors who move fast and want auto-generated subtitles without DaVinci Resolve's manual captioning workflow.
title_en: Subtitle Generator for DaVinci Resolve — Auto-generate captions for videos
